main.description: Tell the app that the caller's own community space exists. A writer's client creates the space (a tools.umbrae.space at the community's key, with a published managed policy naming this app) before its first write there, then calls this. The app syncs it at once and registers for update notifications. Writers only, and rate-limited per caller. Served by the community's managing app, at the service its ref's app names, with atproto service auth (iss the caller, aud the app, lxm this method); clients call through their PDS with atproto-proxy set to the ref's app.

key.description: The community's key within this app.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: Not a community this managing app manages.

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.description: The caller lacks the role this needs.

errors.name: NotAdmitted
errors.description: The managing app doesn't admit this account.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: The caller's community space doesn't exist, or fails the policy check: a published managed policy naming this app.
